name: Easy Player – YouTube, Vimeo & HTML5 Video Player
author: WP Easy Soft

sections.description:
Easy Player is a simple and flexible WordPress video player plugin for adding responsive videos to your website.

Create and display HTML5 videos, MP4 videos, WebM videos, OGG videos, YouTube videos, and Vimeo videos with the Video.js media player.

Easy Player works with both the Gutenberg block editor and shortcodes, making it easy to add a video player to posts, pages, and other WordPress content.

Whether you need a WordPress HTML5 video player, MP4 video player, YouTube video player, Vimeo video player, or Video.js player, Easy Player provides a lightweight way to add video playback to your website.

Supported Video Types

  • HTML5 video
  • MP4 video
  • WebM video
  • OGG video
  • YouTube video
  • Vimeo video

How to use Easy Player – Video Tutorial

Gutenberg Video Player

Add a video player directly from the WordPress Gutenberg block editor.

The Easy Player block allows you to insert a configured video player without manually writing shortcode code.

WordPress Video Player Shortcode

Easy Player supports automatically generated shortcodes as well as manually configured shortcodes.

Use a saved video player:

[easy-player ID="1"]

Or add a video directly:

[easy-player src="video-url" type="mp4"]

You can also use supported video sources such as YouTube:

[easy-player src="youtube-video-url" type="youtube"]

Video.js HTML5 Video Player

Easy Player uses Video.js to provide the video player interface and supports HTML5 video playback along with YouTube and Vimeo.

The player includes controls and settings designed for a smooth viewing experience across desktop and mobile devices.

Key Features

  • Multiple video player management
  • Video player preview
  • Preload option
  • Autoplay option
  • Muted playback
  • Loop video
  • Reset video on end
  • Playback speed control
  • Smooth seeking
  • Playsinline support
  • Big play button
  • Progress control
  • Current time display
  • Remaining time display
  • Negative time display
  • Volume control
  • Fullscreen control
  • Picture-in-Picture control
  • Poster image support
  • Aspect ratio option
  • Player theme option
  • Lightweight and responsive interface

Responsive Video Player

Easy Player is designed to work across different screen sizes, helping you display videos on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

The Playsinline option can also be used to improve video playback behavior on mobile devices.

YouTube Video Player

Add YouTube videos to your WordPress website using Easy Player and display them through the Video.js-powered player interface.

Vimeo Video Player

Easy Player also supports Vimeo videos, allowing you to add Vimeo content to WordPress posts and pages using the video player.

HTML5 Self-Hosted Video

Display your own video files using supported HTML5 formats such as:

  • MP4
  • WebM
  • OGG

This makes Easy Player useful for websites that need to display self-hosted video content without relying exclusively on external video platforms.

Use Cases

Easy Player can be used for:

  • Website video content
  • Video tutorials
  • Online courses
  • Product demonstration videos
  • Training videos
  • Video presentations
  • YouTube videos
  • Vimeo videos
  • Self-hosted HTML5 videos
  • MP4 video content
  • Video portfolios
  • Blog post videos

Why Easy Player?

  • Simple WordPress video player
  • Supports HTML5, YouTube, and Vimeo
  • Uses the popular Video.js player
  • Gutenberg block support
  • Shortcode support
  • Responsive video playback
  • Multiple player controls
  • Easy video player management
  • No complicated setup required

Support

For support, feature request, or any inquiries, please email at nashirbabu@gmail.com
sections.installation:
From the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for Easy Player.
  3. Click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate.
  5. Go to the Easy Player section in your WordPress dashboard.
  6. Create or configure a video player.
  7. Add the Easy Player Gutenberg block or shortcode to your post or page.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Easy Player plugin.
  2. Upload the easy-player folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Create a video player.
  5. Add it to your content using the Gutenberg block or shortcode.
sections.faq:
Does Easy Player support YouTube and Vimeo videos?

Yes. Easy Player supports YouTube, Vimeo, and native HTML5 video (MP4, WebM, OGG) out of the box.

Can I add a video player without using the block editor?

Yes. Every video can also be embedded with a simple shortcode, e.g. [easy-player ID="1"], so the plugin works with the classic editor, page builders, or widgets too.

Does the plugin work with the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. Easy Player includes a dedicated Gutenberg block so you can add and configure a video player directly from the block editor.

Is Easy Player mobile-friendly and responsive?

Yes. The player is fully responsive and includes a Playsinline option optimized for mobile playback.

What playback controls does Easy Player support?

Autoplay, mute, loop, playback speed, volume, fullscreen, progress bar, and remaining/negative time display — see Key Features above for the full list.
